title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 21 ]

items.text: The President appointed him his secretary.
What has brought you here?
alternatives: What brought you here?
What's brought you here?
What brings you here?

items.text: Can you give me a hand?
alternatives: Could you give me a hand?

items.text: I'm sorry but I have my hands full.
alternatives: Sorry, but I have my hands full.
I'm sorry, but I've got my hands full.

items.text: Give me a break this time.
alternatives: This time, give me a break.
Please give me a break this time.

items.text: They lent me some money.
alternatives: They loaned me some money.
They lent me a little money.

items.text: I want to borrow some money.
alternatives: I'd like to borrow some money.
I want to borrow a little money.

items.text: Wish me luck.
alternatives: Please wish me luck.
Wish me good luck.

items.text: I wish you the best of luck.
My father wanted to make me a lawyer.
He made it.
I must make you an apology.
alternatives: I owe you an apology.
I have to make you an apology.
I should make you an apology.

items.text: Let me make amends to you for your loss.
alternatives: Let me make amends to you for your losses.
Please let me make amends to you for your loss.

items.text: He made his mother happy.
Prosperity makes friends.
I will make you a new dress.
alternatives: I'm going to make you a new dress.

items.text: What kind of a king will he make?
alternatives: What kind of king will he make?
What sort of king will he make?
What kind of king would he make?
What type of king will he make?

items.text: Love makes all men equal.
alternatives: Love makes all people equal.
Love makes everyone equal.
Love makes everybody equal.

items.text: He made the burden heavier.
alternatives: He made the load heavier.
He made the luggage heavier.

items.text: He made a great contribution to the rescue effort.
alternatives: He made a big contribution to the rescue effort.
He made a great contribution to the rescue efforts.
He made a large contribution to the rescue effort.

items.text: You may make free use of my library.
alternatives: You can make free use of my library.
You may make free use of my study.
You can make free use of my study.

items.text: I felt guilty.
I feel tired.
